run_pseudo_decomp_bert: run the BERT pseudo-decomposition script to find nearest-neighbor question alignments between SQuAD and HotpotQA
run_main_bert_split: run main_bert with --split dev --beam_size 100 --layer 0 --data_folder ./results to index and search question embeddings
run_main_bert_min_max_len: run main_bert with --min_q_len 4 --max_q_len 20 to filter questions by token length before indexing
run_main_bert_use_mined: run main_bert with use_mined_qs enabled to include mined simple questions in the index alongside SQuAD questions
run_faiss_index_flat_ip: run faiss IndexFlatIP indexing on L2-normalized BERT embeddings for cosine similarity nearest-neighbor search
